title: RWB-S7-E6016-APP: the removal slice has no published operation, no field or list for the removal reason, no plan row for its three consumed contracts, and no requirement id
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6016-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-016; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.1, A1.2, A1.4, A2.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-07 and R-WO-08; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-04
description: (1) No source publishes a REST operation for the removal: TSD S7 T-A.1 lists only API-S7-001 POST /write-off-scans and API-S7-002 POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision, and the legacy Endpoints table of every S7 story repeats those same two rows, while FSD S7 A2.4 describes an officer acting on SCR-27. (2) removal_reason is the only condition of R-WO-07 yet it has no column in write_off (TSD S7 T3.1), no entry in the FSD S7 A2.4.3.2 field catalog and no list of values; TSD S7 T3.2 publishes no list at all. (3) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6016-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case population, answers the rwb-case case move and reads the rwb-decision package, so three consumed rows have no plan row. (4) The service owns topic rwb.writeoff.events.v1 with event EV-24, yet DP-09 is absent from the pattern set of this key, so RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (5) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates the WO route set of 51 rules over 27 states, so no Drools kit row RWB-PLT-E1072-CON or C row RWB-P7-E1073-CON is held. (6) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which this service may read or write, and the legacy endpoints carry the monolith base /api/recovery/v1. (7) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice, and no REQ-S7 row covers a removal from the proposed population. (8) R-WO-08 returns a removed case to SCAN_DUE and no story of this split claims that step.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S7-E6016-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-05 and DP-09 rows; context pack ownership rows (write_off S7, 2 REST operations, event EV-24, job JOB-16, workflow WriteOffWorkflow); TSD S7 T-A.1 endpoint inventory and T3.1, T3.2 field and list tables; FSD S7 A2.4.3.1, A2.4.3.2 and Requirements served; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-07 and R-WO-08; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 FEAT-WOF-04; legacy RWB-E6-016 Data, Endpoints, Acceptance criteria and Guardrails
area: Operation surface, field definition, dependency and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; add the removal operation to the write-off base with a placeholder path and element names until the solution architect confirms them; record the rwb-case and rwb-decision rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; record RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the wave 0 library the service's topic needs and RWB-PLT-E1072-CON with RWB-P7-E1073-CON as the rule kit the stage needs; declare the reason as free-text removal_reason validated as present and stored in the decision record; leave the deviation hold of R-WO-06 with RWB-S7-E6017-APP and the clearing path of R-WO-08 unclaimed; carry the requirement with a placeholder

title: RWB-S7-E6016-CON: the removal operation, its element names, the reason field and the three consumed operation names have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6016-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-016; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.4.2, A2.4.3.1, A2.4.3.2, A2.4.4.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-07
description: (1) TSD S7 T-A.1 publishes no removal operation and the legacy Endpoints table repeats the scan and the committee decision for every S7 story, so the path, the operation id and the two element names of the removal are not in any source. (2) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, and the S7 row of the connection matrix names only Temporal to P7 and P8 with REST and events to P1, so the case move is declared as the child workflow's stage outcome and any REST case-move operation carries a placeholder. (3) TSD S7 T3.2 is an empty list-of-values table, so the baseline can publish no enumeration, and the removal reason has neither a length nor a list. (4) TSD S7 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy set. (5) TSD S7 T3.1 gives the physical columns of write_off but publishes no OpenAPI element, so the element names, required flags and formats are fixed by this baseline. (6) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares three consumed rows.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 only, T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids, T3.1 field list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 and the empty T3.2 list table; context pack connection-matrix row S7; FSD S7 A2.4.4.4 (no background event beyond the scan); legacy RWB-E6-016 messages MSG-S7-001, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003 and its Endpoints table
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the case boundary as the child workflow's input, signals and stage outcome, declare the reason as free text with no enumeration, confirm the path and the element names with the solution architect before the tag, and record the tag date in the contract README
